domain_queries.answer: The machine learning algorithms evaluated in this study included decision tree classifier (DTC), k-nearest neighbors (KNN) algorithm, and support vector machine (SVM).

domain_queries.answer: The SHT40 Temperature & Humidity Sensor, SGP30 Indoor Air Quality Sensor, and Pizza spoilage detection employ sensors and microcontrollers to monitor temperature, humidity, and grain quality.
